caption: Every business needs a bookkeeper. Yours costs twelve pounds ninety nine a month. It does not sleep, it does not invoice you for a phone call, and it has never lost a receipt. An accountant answers on Tuesday. This one answers now: text it a photo at nine at night from the van and it is logged, sorted and categorised before you are home. It does not replace your accountant and it is not trying to. It makes sure they are not doing your books out of a carrier bag in January. If you want something from us today without giving us anything, the invoice generator is free and does not ask you to sign up. Fill it in, send it as a PDF, get paid.
